goal: 完成一次鼓舞人心的奋斗故事分享

n1.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n1.line: Welcome to our sharing session. To inspire your classmates, you are going to tell your own story of struggle today.
n1.lineCn: 欢迎来到我们的分享会。为了激励同学们,你今天将讲述自己的奋斗故事。

grammar.name: 不定式作目的状语
grammar.note: To inspire your classmates 置于句首,说明说话目的,比 in order to 更正式。

options.text: Thank you. Having struggled for years, I am glad to share my experience.
options.textCn: 谢谢。经历了多年的奋斗,我很高兴分享我的经历。
options.feedback: 开场大方得体,分享开始。

options.text: I am not sure I have any story worth telling. My life is rather ordinary.
options.textCn: 我不确定自己有值得讲的故事。我的生活相当平凡。
options.feedback: 低估自己,Zoe 会鼓励你。

options.text: I will tell it, but to be honest, I doubt anyone will find it inspiring.
options.textCn: 我会讲,但说实话,我怀疑没人会觉得它励志。
options.feedback: 缺乏自信,主持人帮你打气。

n2.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n2.line: Perfect. To begin with, tell us what motivated you to keep going when things got tough.
n2.lineCn: 很好。首先请告诉我们,当处境艰难时,是什么激励你坚持下去。

grammar.name: 不定式作状语(目的/宾语)
grammar.note: what motivated you to keep going 中不定式 to keep going 作宾语补足语,表动作目的。

options.text: To make my family proud, I studied under streetlights after working all day.
options.textCn: 为了让家人骄傲,我每天工作结束后在路灯下学习。
options.feedback: 细节真实感人,观众动容。

options.text: I am not sure what kept me going. I guess I was simply too stubborn to quit.
options.textCn: 我不确定是什么让我坚持。大概是我太倔强,不肯放弃。
options.feedback: 质朴坦诚,同样动人。

options.text: Honestly, I would rather not talk about the hardships. They embarrass me.
options.textCn: 说实话,我不想谈那些艰辛。它们让我难堪。
options.feedback: 回避困难,Zoe 会开导你。

n3.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n3.line: Remember, to move others, you must first be honest with yourself. Sit down and take a breath.
n3.lineCn: 记住,要打动别人,你必须先对自己诚实。坐下来,深呼吸。

grammar.name: 不定式作目的状语(打动)
grammar.note: to move others 作目的状语,强调先真诚面对自己才能打动他人。

options.text: You are right. I will start from the night I almost gave up.
options.textCn: 你说得对。我从那个我几乎放弃的夜晚讲起。
options.feedback: 鼓起勇气,找到切入点。

options.text: I still feel nervous. To calm down, let me close my eyes for a minute.
options.textCn: 我还是紧张。为了冷静,让我闭眼一分钟。
options.feedback: 坦诚调整状态,观众理解。

options.text: To find courage, I will imagine I am telling my story to my younger self.
options.textCn: 为了找到勇气,我就想象自己在对年少时的自己讲故事。
options.feedback: 独特的方法,效果不错。

n4.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n4.line: Wonderful, the audience is listening closely. Facing the hardest moment of your journey, what did you choose to do?
n4.lineCn: 太好了,观众都在认真听。面对你人生中最艰难的时刻,你选择了怎么做?

grammar.name: 现在分词作状语(面对)
grammar.note: Facing the hardest moment 作时间/伴随状语,分词逻辑主语即句子主语 you。

options.text: Facing failure, I chose to start over from the very beginning.
options.textCn: 面对失败,我选择从头再来。
options.feedback: 勇气可嘉,观众热烈鼓掌。

options.text: I cried all night and almost gave up. Encouraged by my mother, I tried once more.
options.textCn: 我哭了一整夜,几乎放弃。在母亲的鼓励下,我又试了一次。
options.feedback: 真实感人,引起共鸣。

options.text: To be honest, I nearly abandoned everything at that point.
options.textCn: 说实话,那一刻我几乎放弃了一切。
options.feedback: 坦诚承认脆弱,观众屏息。

n4b.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n4b.line: That is honesty. Tell us, trapped in hardship, how did you find the strength to rise?
n4b.lineCn: 这是真诚。请告诉我们,身处困境时,你是如何找到站起来的勇气?

grammar.name: 过去分词作状语(被动)
grammar.note: trapped in hardship 是过去分词短语作状语,表被动状态,主语 you 承受被困处境。

options.text: Trapped in poverty, I took any job I could find and saved every penny for books.
options.textCn: 身陷贫困,我做一切能找到的工作,省下每一分钱买书。
options.feedback: 细节具体,深深打动听众。

options.text: Having no money for tuition, I borrowed notes from my classmates.
options.textCn: 因为没有钱交学费,我向同学借笔记。
options.feedback: 真实朴素,听众感同身受。

options.text: I do not want to dwell on the past. To look forward is all I care about.
options.textCn: 我不想纠缠过去。向前看才是我关心的。
options.feedback: 回避细节,Zoe 温和引导。

n5.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n5.line: Embarrassment has no place in a story of struggle. To win respect, you must first respect your own past.
n5.lineCn: 奋斗故事里没有难堪的位置。要赢得尊重,你首先要尊重自己的过去。

grammar.name: 不定式作目的状语(赢得)
grammar.note: To win respect 表目的,强调尊重过去是赢得他人尊重的前提。

options.text: You are right. I will share the whole story, painful as it is.
options.textCn: 你说得对。我会分享全部故事,尽管它令人痛苦。
options.feedback: 放下包袱,真诚分享。

options.text: I cannot do it. Rather than feeling embarrassed, I would rather stay silent.
options.textCn: 我做不到。与其难堪,我宁愿保持沉默。
options.feedback: 拒绝继续,分享失败。

options.text: I will not give up, but let me start with a lighter part of the story first.
options.textCn: 我不会放弃,但请允许我先讲轻松一点的部分。
options.feedback: 逐步适应,分享继续。

n6.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n6.line: That courage deserves applause! Determined to start over, how did you rebuild your confidence?
n6.lineCn: 这份勇气值得掌声!下定决心重新开始,你是如何重建自信的?

grammar.name: 过去分词作状语(下定决心)
grammar.note: Determined to start over 是固定搭配的过去分词短语作状语,表状态与决心。

options.text: Determined to succeed, I woke up at five every morning to study.
options.textCn: 下定决心要成功,我每天早晨五点起床学习。
options.feedback: 行动力十足,听众肃然起敬。

options.text: Having learned from my mistakes, I changed my whole method of learning.
options.textCn: 从错误中吸取教训后,我彻底改变了学习方法。
options.feedback: 善于反思,分享渐入佳境。

options.text: I made a plan, but having tried so many times, I was not sure it would work.
options.textCn: 我制定了计划,但尝试了太多次,不确定它会不会奏效。
options.feedback: 真实而不确定,更显动人。

n6b.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n6b.line: A restart demands both courage and method. Determined to change, how did you protect your new habits?
n6b.lineCn: 重新开始需要勇气和方法。下定决心改变的你,是如何守护新习惯的?

grammar.name: 过去分词作状语(改变)
grammar.note: Determined to change 强调内心的坚定状态,与主句主语 you 保持逻辑一致。

options.text: To protect my new habits, I removed every distraction from my desk.
options.textCn: 为了保护新习惯,我把书桌上的所有干扰物都清掉了。
options.feedback: 方法具体可行,值得借鉴。

options.text: I wrote my goals on the wall so that I would see them every morning.
options.textCn: 我把目标写在墙上,这样每天早上都能看到。
options.feedback: 用环境提醒自己,听众赞同。

options.text: I did not. The same laziness crept back again and again.
options.textCn: 我没有守住。同样的懒惰一次又一次溜了回来。
options.feedback: 真实不美化,同样动人。

n7.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n7.line: Amazing. To keep the audience engaged, could you share one concrete achievement of that period?
n7.lineCn: 太棒了。为了让听众保持投入,你能分享那个阶段一个具体的成就吗?

grammar.name: 不定式作目的状语(保持)
grammar.note: To keep the audience engaged 作目的状语,engaged 是过去分词作宾语补足语。

options.text: Having struggled for two years, I finally passed the exam with the highest score in my class.
options.textCn: 奋斗两年后,我终于以全班最高分通过了考试。
options.feedback: 成果辉煌,全场掌声雷动。

options.text: I improved my ranking from the bottom to the top ten. That made me believe in myself again.
options.textCn: 我的排名从垫底提升到前十。这让我重新相信自己。
options.feedback: 进步显著,鼓舞人心。

options.text: Achievements sound like bragging. To stay humble, I would rather not mention any.
options.textCn: 谈成绩像炫耀。为了保持谦虚,我宁愿不提。
options.feedback: 过分谦虚,主持人会引导。

n8.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n8.line: Outstanding! To end this story, what message do you want your classmates to take home?
n8.lineCn: 出色!作为故事的结尾,你想让同学们带走什么讯息?

grammar.name: 不定式作目的状语(收尾)
grammar.note: To end this story 作目的状语,结构正式,适合演讲收尾。

options.text: To anyone struggling now: never give up, because persistence always pays off.
options.textCn: 致现在仍在挣扎的人:永不放弃,因为坚持总有回报。
options.feedback: 金句有力,全场起立鼓掌。

options.text: I hope they learn that failure is not the opposite of success but a part of it.
options.textCn: 我希望他们明白,失败不是成功的对立面,而是成功的一部分。
options.feedback: 见解深刻,引发共鸣。

options.text: I am too moved to continue. Could someone else finish the speech for me?
options.textCn: 我太激动说不下去了。能让别人替我讲完吗?
options.feedback: 临场放弃,分享草草收场。

n9.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
n9.line: Thank you for that powerful sharing. Encouraged by your story, I am sure many classmates will keep striving.
n9.lineCn: 感谢你充满力量的分享。受你故事的鼓舞,我相信很多同学会继续努力。

grammar.name: 过去分词作状语(受鼓舞)
grammar.note: Encouraged by your story 是过去分词短语作原因状语,表被动的鼓舞状态。

options.text: Thank you for listening. Knowing that my story helps others, I feel truly proud.
options.textCn: 谢谢聆听。知道我的故事能帮助别人,我由衷地自豪。
options.feedback: 分享圆满,气氛达到高潮。

options.text: I am glad it is over. To be honest, I never wanted to stand here in the first place.
options.textCn: 我很高兴结束了。说实话,我一开始就不想站上来。
options.feedback: 真诚但扫兴,分享留下遗憾。

options.text: Knowing I might fail again, I still chose to speak today. That is enough.
options.textCn: 明知可能再次失败,我今天仍然选择开口。这已经够了。
options.feedback: 掷地有声,分享圆满结束。

success.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
success.line: Your story has planted a seed in every heart here. Well done, and thank you.
success.lineCn: 你的故事在每个人心里种下了一颗种子。做得漂亮,谢谢你。

fail1.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
fail1.line: I respect your choice, but your story deserves a voice. I hope you will try again next time.
fail1.lineCn: 我尊重你的选择,但你的故事值得被讲述。希望你下次再试一次。

fail2.speaker: 主持人 Zoe
fail2.line: A story unfinished leaves its listeners uneasy. Next time, walk your words to the very end.
fail2.lineCn: 一个没讲完的故事让听众心悬着。下次,请把你的话讲到最后一刻。
